CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship over Creation.
   C. Say Stewardship over Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Stewardship over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)

   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs
